newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Public Service files suit on restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Public Service files suit on restructuring.

text.p: Pinnacle West Capital Corp's Arizona Public Service Co (APS) said Friday it filed a lawsuit addressing a recent state rulemaking on electric utility restructuring.
In December, the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC), issued a plan to deregulate the state's electricity industry over a four year period beginning in 1999.
"There is a 'speak now or forever hold your peace' requirement under the law," said Bill Post, APS chief executive officer.
But he emphasized the utility will continue to focus on working with the ACC to bring competitive benefits to Arizona.
Post added that formalized hearings, legislative action, federal, state and local tax implications and legal issues need to be addressed along with several other key issues.
APS believes that formal hearings before the Commission are necessary to hasten the move to open competition.

The utility also said more work needs to be done on the structure of the market, reciprocity among state and out-of-state competitors, system reliability, recovery of stranded costs and specifics for the phase-in process.
